caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, light tan ceramic jar or crock placed against a plain, off-white background. The jar has a slightly darker interior and a pronounced rim near the top edge. Decoratively painted on the visible side is a blue floral design consisting of a curved stem with a flower bud and a few leaves. The blue decoration is the only color contrast on the jar. The composition centers the jar with ample empty space around it. The artist’s signature, “GEO. L. LOCHRIDGE,” appears to the right and slightly below the jar on the surface.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
